definition: [ חֲוָה ] verb Pa. Haph`el ( M § 65 c ) declare ( ᵑ7 Syriac; Biblical Hebrew III. [ חָוָה ] (late)); — Pa`el with accusative פִּשְׁרָא (or equivalent ): Imperfect 3 masculine singular suffix יְחַוִּנַּ֫נִי (suffix person Indirect object) Dan 5:7 , יְּחֵוִנֵּהּ Dan 2:11 ( קֳדָּם person); 1 singular אֲחַוֶה Dan 2:24 ( ל of person), 1 plural אְחַוֶּה v Dan 2:4 . Haph`el usually with accusative פִשְׁרָא (or equivalent ): Imperfect 3 masculine singular יְהַחֲוֶה Dan 5:12 2 masculine plural תְּהַחֲוֺן Dan 2:6 , suffix (of indirect object) תְחַחֲוֻ֫נַּנִי v Dan 2:9 1 plural נְהַחֲוֶה v Dan 2:7 Imperative masculine plural suffix (of indirect object) הַחֲוֺ֑נִי v Dan 2:6 Infinitive לְהַחֲוָיָה v Dan 2:10 ; Dan 5:15 + ל person Dan 2:16 . Dan 2:27 with accusative of signs and wonders Dan 3:32 .
